black_hole_nomad_init = {
	class = "sc_black_hole"
	usage = nomad_init
	flags = {
			empire_home_system
		}
	init_effect = {
		spawn_system = { initializer = neighbor_t1 }
		spawn_system = { initializer = neighbor_t1_first_colony }
	}
}
